text:
maria: Holding the cut for v1.43.1. CI is failing: registry push timed out and integration-e2e is tripping on a DB seed serialization error. change window ends in ~35m. quick triage?
lee: saw the push fail in the build logs:```Uploading artifact to gcr.io/redwood-inference/releases/v1.43.1
ERROR: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
Exit status: 1```
omar: storage telemetry shows a short S3/GCS burst in us-west-2 earlier (linked to INC-2031). but seed errors also show `could not serialize access due to concurrent update`. two separate failure modes.
jen: release notes prepared, but we need a go/no-go. options: pin to last-good digest + rerun, rerun several times, or abort and cut a rollback release.
ci-runner: retried integration-e2e (attempt 2) queued. previous run failed during seed: `psql: error: could not serialize access due to concurrent update`.
maria: leaning to pin+rerun and avoid a full rollback during the window. if push keeps failing we abort.
lee: last-green image sha: `sha256:af12c3d4`. I can update manifest and do manual promote. @deploy-bot pause auto-promo.
deploy-bot: auto-promotion paused for thread 1759991230 by lee. manual promote requested.
omar: FYI PR #4180 bumped the baseimage and also added a torsion in the DB seed ordering. Could be the root cause for the seed flake. If we pin the image but keep the baseimage bump, we might still hit the seed race.
jen: then plan: pin artifact to last-green sha AND revert PR #4180 in the release branch. quick revert PR ready, just needs a reviewer.
lee: applying pin to release manifest now. kicking manual promote. ci-runner: manual promote started at 1759991305. building and pushing...
ci-runner: push attempt 1 failed: DeadlineExceeded. retrying (attempt 2).
lee: if registry keeps timing out we can attempt a mirror push to us-east temporarily (manual step). not ideal but can unblock.
omar: filed infra ticket and flagged INC-2031 to infra oncall. added a note to the release thread.
maria: timeline: if no successful promote + passing e2e by 1759991630 (35m) we abort to v1.43.0. agree?
lee: agree, monitoring logs. :eyes:
ci-runner: manual promote succeeded at 1759991402. integration-e2e started.
ci-runner: integration-e2e failed first run (seed race), retried and then passed on attempt 2. all checks green.
jen: merging revert PR to release branch and updating changelog to reflect the pin and infra delay.
lee: final promote to prod now. @deploy-bot resume auto-promotion for future cuts.
deploy-bot: auto-promotion resumed by lee. release v1.43.1 promoted at 1759991520.
maria: thanks team. follow-up actions: add a guard to block baseimage bumps during change windows and add retry/backoff for registry pushes across regions.
